en: Divided-image postcard. The front shows two black‑and‑white views: at top, the main building of the Berlin University (today Humboldt University) with people, horse carriages and early automobiles on the street; at bottom, a panorama of Hermannstadt (Sibiu) in Siebenbürgen/Transylvania with church spires and snow‑covered mountains behind. The back bears German text announcing a 27 Feb. 1914 trip to Siebenbürgen organized by a Berlin group, with the word "Postkarte" and address lines.
